fullContentHtml:
RSSB Driver Result 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the result for the post of Driver. This recruitment was released for 2756 posts. Applications for the Rajasthan RSSB Driver Recruitment 2025 were accepted from February 27, 2025, to March 28, 2025. The online examination was held on 23 November 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RSSB Driver Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date : 12 December 2024
  • Application Start Date : 27 February 2025
  • Last Date : 28 March 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 March 2025
  • Exam Date : 23 November 2025
  • Admit Card : 19 November 2025
  • Answer Key : 10 December 2025
  • Result : 17 January 2026
  • Score Card : 01 February 2026
  • Result : 29 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer) : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RSSB Driver Result 2026?

RSSB Driver Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
